[Benzinga news, 2026-11-02T13:02:15Z, by staff] Marvell Technology to Acquire Lumentum in $115 Billion All-Stock Merger
Marvell Technology and Lumentum Holdings Inc. have entered into a definitive agreement to merge in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $115 billion.
Under the terms of the agreement, Lumentum shareholders will receive 4.5 shares of Marvell common stock for each share of Lumentum stock they own, representing a premium of approximately 23.9%. The deal, which has been unanimously approved by the boards of both companies, aims to create a leader in artificial intelligence connectivity. Upon completion, Marvell shareholders are expected to own approximately 67% of the combined entity, while Lumentum shareholders will own about 33% on a fully diluted basis. The transaction is valued at $115 billion, including debt.
